title: Align CSV columns manually
brief: A small CSV table has uneven spacing after commas. Add spaces so all values align in neat columns.

expect.text:
name, age, city
Alice, 30, NYC
Bob, 25, LA
Charlie, 35, Chicago

why: Using :%s with \zs (start of match) inserts a space after each comma without replacing the comma itself.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Use substitute with a zero-width assertion.
